integrity: A self-contained degree-induction proof and finite exhaustive original-algebra computations are included. Finite-field computations are not used as a proof of the general theorem.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns only the nonunital free nilpotent associative tensor algebra truncated by word length; arbitrary quotients, noncommuting idempotents, non-idempotent endomorphisms, and scheme structures are not classified. Historical novelty is provisional.
title: Simultaneous linearization and an exact census of commuting retractions of truncated free associative algebras
